[EN] Even Kulkaris Get the Blues
[ES] Hasta los kulkaris se ponen tristes
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate the {@creature:46#201#argonomorph kulkari crushers}.
[ES] Elimina a los {@creature:46#201#argonomorph kulkari crushers}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The only thing worse than a kulkari is a {@creature:46#201#argonomorph kulkari crusher}.
[ES] Lo único peor que un kulkari es un {@creature:46#201#argonomorph kulkari crusher}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill the {@creature:46#201#argonomorph kulkari crushers} guarding the rooms in the {@Rgn:46003$$Raga Shadi} part of {@Rgn:46001$$the Three Towers}.
[ES] Mata a los {@creature:46#201#argonomorph kulkari crushers} que custodian las salas en la zona de {@Rgn:46003$$Raga Shadi} de {@Rgn:46001$$the Three Towers}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I've had a lot of kulkari practice."
[ES] "Tengo mucha práctica con los kulkaris."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the {@Rgn:46019$$Beastroar Chamber} and report to {@linkcreature:246#1025$$Alecian}.
[ES] Ve a la {@Rgn:46019$$Beastroar Chamber} e infórmale a {@linkcreature:246#1025$$Alecian}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
